wants.topic: Hidden/secret history framing — "truths kept hidden for centuries"
wants.evidence: Kahani Ka Safar's top 2 videos (97x, 60x vsNormal) use 'छिपाकर रखा गया' (kept hidden), 'सच' (truth), 'दुनिया से छिपाकर' phrasing; India Doc's 196x video frames independence as '200 साल की गुलामी का अंत' (end of 200-year slavery)

wants.topic: Intelligence/RAW operations with named operatives (Ajit Doval, specific missions)
wants.evidence: India Doc's 65x video: '3 Pakistani Spies... सामने थे Ajit Doval || Raw Mastermind Operation'; viewers gravitate to named modern spymasters and declassified-style ops

wants.topic: Freedom struggle — but specific turning points, not overviews; Part-2/series continuations
wants.evidence: India Doc's 196x video is 'Part-2' on 'कैसे मिली भारत को AZADI'; outperforms standalone overviews massively

wants.topic: Modern political/underworld history — named figures (Bal Thackeray, Dawood Ibrahim), traps, escapes
wants.evidence: India Doc's 44x video: 'How Did Bal Thackeray Escape Dawood Ibrahim's Trap | D-Company Secret Plan'; real-life thriller framing works

wants.topic: "How" questions on ancient Indian achievements — engineering, agriculture, knowledge systems
wants.evidence: History Industry's 12x video: 'आदिमानव ने खेती की शुरुआत कैसे की?' (how agriculture started); 7x: 'पिरामिड कैसे बनाए?' (how pyramids built); 3x: 'शुरुआती जीवन कैसा था?'

wants.topic: Forgotten/unsung warriors & lineages — regional heroes erased from mainstream narratives
wants.evidence: Kahani Ka Safar's 15x video: 'शूरवीर, एक ऐसे वीर योद्धा की महागाथा, जिसे जानने के लिए सदियों का समय लगा'; 'अग्निवंश' (fire lineage) hidden history

wants.topic: Destruction/end narratives — "creation to destruction" arcs for institutions/cities
wants.evidence: kwy true tale's 4x video: 'नालंदा की पूरी कहानी - creation to its destruction'; India Doc's 196x: 'गुलामी का अंत' (end of slavery)

wants.topic: Comprehensive sweep videos with massive timelines (9000BC–present) — but only as entry points
wants.evidence: kwy true tale's 5x video: 'Complete history of India | 9000BC to 2026AD'; works as gateway, not deep dive

title_patterns: "X साल का सच/रहस्य/कहानी" — time-anchored mystery framing
"कैसे [verb]..." — specific "how" questions (कैसे मिली, कैसे बनाए, कैसे की शुरुआत)
"छिपाकर रखा गया" / "दुनिया से छिपा" — active concealment narrative
"[Named Figure] + Trap/Secret Plan/Mastermind Operation" — thriller framing with real names
"Creation to Destruction" / "शुरुआत से अंत तक" — full arc promise
"वीर योद्धा की महागाथा" / "अनसुनी दास्तान" — unsung hero epic framing
